abort.not_supported: The Bluetooth device does not appear to be a supported BM2 battery monitor.
abort.cannot_validate: Home Assistant could not confirm that this device is a BM2 battery monitor. The advertisement did not contain a recognised BM2 packet and an active Bluetooth validation could not be completed.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to make a Bluetooth connection.
error.no_data: Unable to read battery info - the selected device doesn't appear to be a BM2 battery monitor.
error.not_bm2: The selected Bluetooth device was checked and does not appear to implement the BM2 protocol.
error.cannot_validate: Home Assistant could not confirm that this device is a BM2 battery monitor. Try again when the device is closer to a Bluetooth adapter/proxy or when another advertisement has been received.

user.title: BM2 Battery Monitor
user.description: Select a Bluetooth device to add. Known BM2 advertisements are validated passively. If the advertisement is inconclusive, Home Assistant will make a one-off active connection attempt to verify the BM2 protocol before creating the integration.

bluetooth_confirm.title: BM2 Battery Monitor discovered
bluetooth_confirm.description:
A supported BM2 battery monitor was detected. Do you want to add `{name}` to Home Assistant?

Routine updates will prefer the active BM2 connection and can fall back to advertisement data where supported.

init.title: Options
init.description:
Sensor updates are only ever done when a Bluetooth advertisement is seen, so the rate limit is a way of throttling updates if the device is sending out a lot of advertisements.

It is recommended to select the appropriate battery chemistry as the BM2 by default has some strange definitions of overall status.

custom_battery_details.title: Custom battery values
custom_battery_details.description: Provide the appropriate voltage thresholds for your battery so its state can be monitored correctly.  The overall percentage will be determined from the 0%, 20%, 50% and 100% figures provided, with interpolation as required.
